violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. The cutting boards on the prep cooler and across from the fryers at gouged and pitted. These are no longer a cleanable surface.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The handles and front of the glass for Pepsi cooler for the hibachi items needs to be cleaned.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. The floor in the walk in freezer needs to be cleaned.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Maintenance equipment, supplies and tools were not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items. Drills and extension cord reels were stored next to food items on the shelf by the back hand sink.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Poisonous or toxic material was not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items. A can of WD-40 was stored next to and over food items by the back hand sink.

Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Equipment/utensil was not air-dried or allowed adequate draining after sanitizing. Witnessed dish employee drying dishes with a yellow towel. Employee was pulling them off the rack as soon as they were out of the dishwasher and not allowing them to air dry.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Clean dishes were placed on yellow towels after washing.

Handling of clean equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not handled in a manner to prevent contamination of food-contact surface. Employee would dry multiple dishes with the same towel.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. The paper towel dispenser for the hand sink by the rice cookers was empty.
